current.main_risk: The central bloc waits for stronger wage evidence.
reasons: Inflation has moved up on every measure I watch: September CPI rose to 3.5% from 3.1%, core to 2.8% from 2.6%, and services to 3.7% from 3.4%.
The argument for waiting is weaker than in September. 68% of firms now expect to raise prices, eleven percentage points more than then, although expected wage growth stayed at 3.4%.
The market already prices a hike at 89.55%, so I did not shade it. The language index is not part of the call.
